item.title: US sanctions on ICC are 'a shock' and 'unacceptable', Nobel peace laureate Navi Pillay says
item.description: In an interview with FRANCE 24, Nobel Peace Prize laureate Navi Pillay described the US sanctions imposed on the International Criminal Court (ICC) hours after her award as "a shock" and "unacceptable". item.description: The legendary 1958 Gibson Flying V guitar, famously owned by Lonnie Mack and dubbed 'Number 7', fetched an impressive $550,000 at auction. This auction also featured Mack's 1962 Magnatone Custom 440 amplifier, which was crucial to his distinct sound. Mack's guitar, tailored for his innovative techniques, has had a profound influence on blues-rock music for many years. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Australia releases 50 critically endangered smoky mice into forest after decades of absence
item.description: Australia has successfully reintroduced almost 50 critically endangered smoky mice into South East Forest National Park. This reintroduction represents a significant step towards restoring the region’s ecosystem and native mammal populations. Various species, including the long-footed potoroo and eastern quoll, are also planned for reintroduction. The effort is part of a broader initiative by the NSW Government and conservationists. item.title: ‘A difficult line’: meet the editors tackling Wikipedia’s arms trade pages
item.description: Volunteers and new recruits come together for ‘wikithon’ to put more detail about industry into public domain “Anyone can edit Wikipedia,” the adage goes. But, it turns out, a relatively small number actually do. What is worthy of a digital page in the world’s largest and most-read encyclopedia is decided by roughly 270,000 active volunteers, enthusiasts who populate the online resource with information on anything from 19th-century medicine to TikTok trends. Inevitably, some subjects are sidelined – the global south, notable women – but a new batch of Wikipedian recruits are waging war on… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
